name: Beef Stew
steps: Heat the 1 tablespoon vegetable oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the diced yellow onion, minced garlic and cook, stirring often, until softened, about 5 minutes.
Pour in the 4 cups vegetable broth and add the 1 3/4 cups beef stew meat, 2/3 cup kidney beans. Bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to low, cover partially, and simmer 30 minutes, until everything is tender.
Remove any bay leaf. Season with the 1/4 teaspoon salt, 2 teaspoons black pepper, 2 teaspoons dried thyme, tasting and adjusting as you go.
Ladle into warm bowls, top with 4 tablespoons cilantro, and serve hot.
